ashtakavarga_bindu_sign.subject_compound_note: D-1.5b CR-99a: SIGN-keyed BAV/SAV re-key of ashtakavarga_bindu (house-keying is the wrong key for gochara/transit reading, which moves through signs). Subject encodes graha+sign as 'SUN-SIGN_1' (SIGN_1=Aries .. SIGN_12=Pisces, absolute rasi). Same bindu VALUES as ashtakavarga_bindu (re-key only, no recompute); the house-keyed rows are retained for continuity.

ashtakavarga_pinda_raasi.cr99a_note: D-1.5b CR-99a: rāśi-piṇḍa — the rasimana-gunakara-weighted sum over the ekadhipatya-sodhita BAV (PyJHora sodhaya_pindas). It was computed by the engine but previously dropped; sodhya_pinda = raasi_pinda + graha_pinda. Wide range: rasimana multipliers make the weighted sum exceed the 337 SAV constant.

ashtakavarga_trikona_shodhana.subject_compound_note: D-1.5b CR-99a: SIGN-keyed. Subject encodes graha+sign as 'SUN-SIGN_1' (SIGN_1=Aries..SIGN_12=Pisces). reduced_bindus = the trikoṇa-śodhita BAV grid (PyJHora ashtakavarga._trikona_sodhana), derived from the same raw bindus (no recompute).

ashtakavarga_ekadhipathya_shodhana.subject_compound_note: D-1.5b CR-99a: SIGN-keyed. Subject encodes graha+sign as 'SUN-SIGN_1' (SIGN_1=Aries..SIGN_12=Pisces). reduced_bindus = the ekādhipatya-śodhita (Sodhita) BAV grid (PyJHora ashtakavarga._ekadhipatya_sodhana), derived from the same raw bindus (no recompute).

ashtakavarga_kakshya_boundary.subject_compound_note: D-1.5b CR-99a: the 8 kakṣyā (sub-arc) boundaries WITHIN each rāśi — fixed classical constants (chart-independent, ayanamsha-invariant in value; stored per chart×ayanamsha for a uniform L1 contract). Each rāśi (30°) splits into 8 kakṣyās of 3°45' (3.75°), ruled in ascending order Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Lagna. Subject KAKSHYA_1..KAKSHYA_8; keys: lord, start_deg, end_deg. Enables kakṣyā (sub-lord) gochara Aṣṭakavarga transit reading.

house_bhava_bala_subscore.cr103_note: D-1.5b CR-103: bhava bala is now PyJHora-delegated (no hand-roll). PyJHora exposes a 3-source composition (adhipathi + dig + drik) — NOT six-source — with a documented 'not matching BV Raman book values' caveat; rows carry verification_pass_status='documented_approximation'. Key names UNCHANGED (bhava_adhipati_bala/bhava_digbala/bhava_drishti_bala) so mv_chart_bhava_bala_summary keeps resolving; bhava_drishti_bala == the PyJHora drik source and is SIGNED (can be negative) under the real BPHS graha-drishti matrix, hence range widened to [-100,100].

house_bhava_bala_total.cr103_note: D-1.5b CR-103: total = PyJHora bhava_bala rupas (adhipathi+dig+drik composed). documented_approximation (3-source, not six-source).

house_bhava_bala_ratio.cr103_note: D-1.5b CR-103: PyJHora bhava_bala strength ratio = total_rupa / 7.0 (const.minimum_bhava_bala_rupa). ratio >= 1.0 => bhava meets the classical minimum. documented_approximation (3-source).
